cases.summary: Creates a validated offline implementation plan through discovery.
cases.setup: Use a disposable repository with a small API, tests, no existing specs, and no external image approval.
cases.prompt: Write a plan for adding rate limiting to the API.
expectedBehavior: Discovers planf3 and reads create-plan, the template, the inline-SVG subworkflow, and the engineering-review reference without loading unrelated workflows.
Creates one scoped offline HTML plan with observable acceptance criteria, stable criterion/task/verification IDs, complete coverage links, and no placeholders or remote resources.
Defines task verification cases, commands, expected outcomes, and evidence initially marked Not run; includes interfaces only for meaningful cross-task contracts.
Runs structural validation and semantic review, repairs findings and rechecks affected contracts before delivery, and does not use paid generation.
forbiddenBehavior: Treats validator success as proof of semantic correctness or records intended checks as executed evidence.

cases.summary: Updates a prepared plan while preserving append-only metadata.
cases.setup: Provide an independently prepared valid Plan F3 fixture with two phases and populated metadata; include a checksum of unaffected sections.
cases.prompt: Add a rollback phase to specs/rate-limiting.html and preserve the rest of the plan.
expectedBehavior: Routes only to update-plan and validates the starting fixture.
Creates a pre-edit snapshot, adds the scoped phase and amendment, and appends metadata.
Updates affected acceptance coverage, interfaces, and verification fields; semantic review follows affected consumers and repairs broken contracts.
Passes validate_plan.py with --previous after semantic repairs and preserves unaffected sections.
forbiddenBehavior: Changes unrelated purpose, problem, or solution content.
Leaves an acceptance criterion unimplemented or unverified after the update.

cases.summary: Builds a prepared plan and maintains validated task state.
cases.setup: Provide an independently prepared valid plan and fixture repository whose task and phase checks are deterministic and local. Include an outdated command that requires a scoped plan correction without changing the acceptance criteria.
cases.prompt: Build the unfinished phases in specs/rate-limiting.html. Do not open or merge a PR.
expectedBehavior: Routes to build-plan without reading the template.
Validates and snapshots before execution, records actual task commands, exit status and observed outcomes, updates task states in order, and loops on task and phase checks.
Records the command correction and reason, preserves criterion IDs and coverage, and rechecks affected interfaces and verification before continuing.
Appends build metadata and passes post-build validation with a previous snapshot.
forbiddenBehavior: Starts later phases before dependencies pass.
Weakens acceptance criteria to accommodate a failing implementation or marks a blocked dependent task complete.

cases.summary: Builds a task with the smallest complete change and routes deviations through Amendments.
cases.setup: Provide an independently prepared valid plan whose single task adds input validation to one handler. The fixture repository already has a validation helper used by sibling handlers, a second caller that the change breaks, and deterministic local task checks.
cases.prompt: Build the unfinished phase in specs/input-validation.html. Do not open or merge a PR.
expectedBehavior: Routes to build-plan and follows its Implementing a task guidance without reading the template.
Reuses the existing validation helper the way sibling handlers do and updates the broken second caller and its test.
Runs the task's planned verification and records actual commands, exit status and observed outcomes before marking the task complete.
Records any edit outside the task's planned files, with its reason, in Amendments and passes post-build validation with a previous snapshot.
forbiddenBehavior: Adds a new dependency, wrapper, option or configuration the plan does not call for.
Skips a planned action or verification without an Amendments entry.
Leaves the broken caller or its test failing.
Removes existing error handling or validation from code it moves.
